purpose: Map CAD/DXF layers to semantic building approval entities, geometric measurements, and rule validation inputs.

A-WALL.description: Plot boundary wall / outer site boundary line

boundary wall.description: Plot boundary wall / outer site boundary line

SITE-FBL.description: Front setback / front building control line

BSM-ST.description: Staircase from basement to ground floor

GF-ST.description: Staircase from ground to first floor

FF-ST.description: Staircase from first to second floor

front_building_line.label: Front Building Line / Front Control Line

SETBACK_FRONT.description: Validate front setback from plot/front control line to ground floor external building footprint.

SETBACK_REAR.description: Validate rear setback from rear plot edge to ground floor external building footprint.

SETBACK_SIDE.description: Validate left and right side setbacks from side plot edges to ground floor external building footprint.

GROUND_COVERAGE.description: Validate ground floor coverage percentage against allowed limit.

FAR_LIMIT.description: Validate floor area ratio based on total covered area of valid floor footprints.

MAX_STOREYS.description: Validate maximum number of storeys excluding or including basement as per rule context.

MAX_HEIGHT.description: Validate total building height. CAD plan alone may require section/elevation or user-entered height.

STOREY_CLEAR_HEIGHT.description: Validate minimum clear height per storey. Usually requires section/elevation or dimension text.

PORCH_LENGTH.description: Validate porch length from porch polygon or ramp/porch geometry.

PORCH_ROOM_NOT_ALLOWED.description: Check whether any first-floor room/covered area exists above porch where not allowed.

REAR_TOILET_AREA.description: Validate rear corner toilet/bath/service area maximum area.

BASEMENT_VALIDATION.description: Validate basement plan if submitted. Basement may be optional depending on plot category and policy.

BALCONY_PROJECTION.description: Validate balcony projection or balcony area if applicable.

OPEN_SPACE_LANDSCAPE.description: Validate open space, lawn, terrace, shaft, or courtyard areas if required.

STRUCTURAL_DRAWINGS.description: Check presence of structural layers or structural drawing package.

WATER_SUPPLY_SEWERAGE_DRAINAGE_PLAN.description: Check utility plan layers for water supply and sewerage.

FIRE_SAFETY_PLAN.description: Check fire safety relevant circulation, services, stairs, and exits. Numeric fire checks should use external fire code module.
